description: Runtime-to-canonical section mapping cases for docs/build/FPP-PLUGIN-COORDINATOR-CONTRACTS.md section 1.2. Unlike entry-key.json, which supplies an already-canonical section and checks only entryKey derivation, these cases start from FPP's own runtime playlist-section string (the spelling FPP's playlist callback reports: LeadIn, MainPlaylist, LeadOut, or New) and pin both the canonical value that runtime string maps to and the entryKey that results from hashing the canonical value. A side that derives entryKey from the runtime string instead of the mapped canonical value produces a different entryKey and fails this case; entry-key.json alone cannot catch that, because it never exercises the runtime spelling.

cases.name: lead-in
cases.description: FPP's runtime section string for the lead-in section, LeadIn, maps to the playlist definition's member name, leadIn.

cases.name: main-playlist
cases.description: FPP's runtime section string for the main section, MainPlaylist, maps to the playlist definition's member name, mainPlaylist.

cases.name: lead-out
cases.description: FPP's runtime section string for the lead-out section, LeadOut, maps to the playlist definition's member name, leadOut.

cases.name: unrecognized-new-passthrough
cases.description: FPP also reports the runtime section string New, which names no member of the playlist definition (leadIn, mainPlaylist, leadOut). Contract section 1.2 mints no canonical spelling for it: it passes through unchanged, so it will not match any parsed definition entry and the coordinator's existing unknown-entry outcome is the visible failure, rather than a silently wrong binding.
